summary: Zillow Group filed an 8-K disclosing it entered into a stipulated final order with the FTC and several state attorneys general resolving antitrust litigation related to its Redfin partnership. The order contains no admission of liability, allows the partnership and multifamily listing syndication to continue through June 2030, and permits standalone advertising products. Zillow pays immaterial fees and costs. This is a regulatory settlement, not a special-situation transaction, and the filing reaffirms financial outlook.
